products.name: Stack AI
products.note: No-code AI app builder; enterprise deployment; workflow automation; data connector governance

profile_text.body:
Stack AI is a software company that describes itself as enabling enterprises to deploy AI agents at scale. Its platform offers a drag-and-drop, no-code interface intended to let organizations build and launch AI applications quickly, and the company claims support for more than 100 enterprise integrations, allowing agents to read, write, and execute tasks within existing systems. The company positions itself as serving a range of industries, including regulated environments such as banking and education.

The company's primary product, also called Stack AI, is categorized as a coding and developer tool and is described as a no-code AI application builder with capabilities spanning workflow automation, enterprise deployment, and data connector governance. Customer remarks quoted on the site reference uses including agentic AI rollout across corporate departments, building AI assistants for students without coding, and running production-ready AI systems in regulated settings.

The held facts confirm Stack AI maintains an active profile on theworldofai.org. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are noted in the available data.
